name: Sterngrit Ore
description: Gritty iron-rich rock from inner belts; refines mostly into sideron. The grit gets into the laser housing and the yard charges to clean it out.

name: Kerngrit Ore
description: Dense metallic ore with a nixium seam; a reliable mid-tier refinery feed. Cutters do not fight over it. Cutters fight over the belt that has it.

name: Lucidite Ore
description: Glassy blue-black ore laced with zaffrite and vetril; a Fringe favourite. It prices by the load and the load is never as big as the survey said.

name: Borealite Ore
description: Frozen frontier ore that yields cryolith crystals and trapped helion. It comes out of the belt cold enough to frost a hold, and the refinery pays for the ice the same as the rock.
